elsebase.configuration.title: Elsebase settings
tooltip.elsebase.anchor: Right-click a floor to move your personal spawn marker.
tooltip.elsebase.portal: Link inside, then outside. Sneak-use a portal to remove it.
tooltip.elsebase.remove: Right-click to remove the highlighted surface; floor borders remain.
tooltip.elsebase.aim: Look at a wall, floor or ceiling. No mode switching.
tooltip.elsebase.create: Right-click to build solid walls or restore floors and ceilings. Shift-right-click: select construction theme.
tooltip.elsebase.scan: Shift-right-click: choose and save a theme. Right-click: scan the aimed room surface into the buffer.
tooltip.elsebase.paint: Right-click: repaint a room surface. Shift-right-click: choose a theme or set your default.
elsebase.ui.choose_a_local_theme_then_im: Choose a local theme, then Import.
elsebase.ui.inherited_surfaces_in_your_r: Inherited surfaces in your region will change.
elsebase.ui.used_surfaces_will_inherit_t: Used surfaces will inherit their region default. This cannot be undone.
elsebase.ui.choose_no_to_keep_it_and_sav: Choose No to keep it and save it first.
elsebase.ui.select_no_to_return_and_save: Select No to return and save your current theme first.
elsebase.ui.cannot_read_personal_library: Cannot read personal library; check folder permissions.
elsebase.ui.update_every_surface_using_t: Update every surface using this template?
elsebase.ui.choose_no_to_keep_the_existi: Choose No to keep the existing template.
elsebase.ui.built_in_and_other_players_t: Built-in and other players' themes are saved as your own copy. Your own theme updates everywhere it is used.
elsebase.ui.choose_no_to_rename_it_inste: Choose No to rename it instead.
elsebase.ui.start_with_plain_stone_scan_: Start with plain stone. Scan walls, floor and ceiling, then preview and save your theme.
elsebase.config.theme_help: Choose a built-in or local library theme. Apply on next world load.
elsebase.configuration.allowInstant.tool: Allow new outside entrances. Existing returns stay usable.
elsebase.configuration.maxPermanentPairs: Zero disables new permanent pairs, not existing ones.
elsebase.configuration.excludedExternalD: Dimension IDs where new entrances are blocked. Return travel remains available.
elsebase.configuration.maxMirroredEndpoi: Limit loaded portal endpoint chunks. Zero disables proactive loading.
elsebase.configuration.maxChangedBlocksP: Global block-edit budget per tick. A surface is changed as one operation.
elsebase.configuration.radius.tooltip: Fixed when the first area is allocated. Changes require a new world.
elsebase.configuration.minimumSpacing.to: Fixed with the radius. Must be divisible by 16.
elsebase.configuration.allowNaturalMobSp: Allow natural spawning independently of visual brightness.
elsebase.configuration.darkness.tooltip: Disable uniform brightness. Player lighting still works. Controlled by the server in multiplayer.
elsebase.configuration.budget.tooltip: Loaded chunks only. Low/Balanced/High: 8/16/32 viewers and 1/2/4 section copies per tick. Off keeps travel.
elsebase.configuration.previewQuality.to: One live portal at most. Active Iris shaders use an animated fallback.
elsebase.configuration.immersivePortalTr: Use an immersive transition only when walking through Elsebase portals.
elsebase.configuration.defaultStyle.tool: Select the global room theme. Personal defaults and painted surfaces take precedence.
elsebase.configuration.allowPlayerImport: Allow validated uploads to the server library.
elsebase.configuration.allowPersonalDefa: Allow players to choose a default theme for their region.
elsebase.configuration.templatesPerPlaye: Maximum number of server themes owned by each player.

elsebase.configuration.requireKnownRetur: Refuses instant portals inside the Backdoor if no outside destination is saved. Known return destinations retain emergency recovery.

elsebase.configuration.startInBackdoor.t: New players start at their personal anchor and respawn there if their chosen respawn point is missing. Existing players and later logins keep their location.
